clue.text: In complete opposItion, some central Europeans excepted

parts.note: people from Poland, in central Europe, are Poles
apart, as in 'apart from', means excepted or excluded

explanation.surface: A remark that some central Europeans are left out of a group which is otherwise wholly opposed to something.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things at opposite ends of the earth are as far apart as can be, an idiom for total disagreement.

clue.text: Speed of expert under pressure

indicators.note: in a down clue the expert's letters sit beneath the pressure letter

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for pressure
an ace is a top performer or expert

explanation.surface: A question of how fast a specialist works when put under strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Pace is a synonym for rate of movement or speed.

clue.text: Tolerant of knight that is breaking fast

indicators.note: the knight-plus-that-is letters break into the fast, splitting it apart

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting
N is the chess notation for a knight
i.e. (id est) means 'that is'

explanation.surface: Someone is indulgent towards a knight who breaks his fast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' reads as quick in the surface, but here it is the noun: Lent is the Christian period of fasting before Easter.
explanation.definitionFit: A lenient person is easy-going and forgiving, synonymous with tolerant.

clue.text: Climber in vivid red, athletic type

parts.note: scarlet is a bright, vivid red
a runner is an athlete

explanation.surface: A mountaineer, or a gym enthusiast, dressed in bright red sportswear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Climber' suggests a person, but here it is a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarlet runner is a bean plant that climbs up poles or canes, so it is a climbing plant.

clue.text: Very strong, round number in gym

indicators.note: the round and the number are placed in the gym letters

parts.note: PT, physical training, is gym class in British schools
a round thing is O-shaped
ten is a number

explanation.surface: A powerful workout of a set number of rounds at the gym.
explanation.definitionFit: Potent means powerful or forceful, a synonym of very strong.

clue.text: To give a facelift to US city, tax highest of earners?

parts.note: Reno is a city in Nevada
VAT, value added tax, is a British sales tax

indicators.note: the top letter of a down entry's word, its first

explanation.surface: A question whether a city gets refurbished by taxing its top earners.
explanation.definitionFit: To renovate a building is to restore and refresh it, as a facelift smartens a face.

clue.text: Beginning to seem backward in culture, behind the times

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: low, as in lowbrow, means unsophisticated or culturally unrefined

explanation.surface: Someone appears unrefined and out of date.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backward' looks like a reversal signal, but it is part of the phrase meaning LOW.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow clock is behind the true time, so slow means lagging or behind the times.

clue.text: Bird got in annexe after friend turned up

indicators.note: the annexe comes after the friend
in a down entry, turning the word upwards reads it backwards

parts.note: a pal is a friend
a wing is an extension or annexe of a building

explanation.surface: A bird flew into a building extension once a friend arrived.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reads PAL backwards to give LAP.
explanation.definitionFit: The lapwing, or peewit, is a plover, a crested wading bird.

clue.text: They may relieve tension in derby as row irrupts

indicators.note: a row bursting out violently scatters these letters

explanation.surface: Something to calm nerves when a quarrel breaks out at a local derby match.
explanation.definitionFit: Worry beads are a string of beads fingered to calm anxiety, so they relieve stress.

clue.text: Get in touch with shrink right way

indicators.note: read as 'away': the right goes away from the shrink word

parts.note: to contract is to shrink

explanation.surface: Advice to consult a psychiatrist straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shrink' looks like the slang for a psychiatrist, but it is the verb to contract.
explanation.definitionFit: To contact someone is to reach out to them by phone or letter.

clue.text: Rank outsider? Work inside on her jumping

indicators.note: the work sits inside the rearranged letters
letters jumping about are rearranged

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A horse that nobody fancies gets some work done while she is jumping.

clue.text: Detective in our helicopter, squirming

indicators.note: squirming means wriggling about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An investigator wriggles about uncomfortably in a helicopter.
explanation.definitionFit: Agatha Christie's famous Belgian sleuth is a fictional private investigator.

clue.text: Thoroughly at home, always? Surely not!

parts.note: well in means well established or on very good terms
ever means always

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a person will always be completely comfortable, and is met with disbelief.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation expresses astonished disbelief, like saying 'Surely not!'

clue.text: Climber in cream, not gold

indicators.note: the gold is removed from the colour word

parts.note: ivory is a creamy off-white colour
or is the heraldic term for gold

explanation.surface: A mountaineer dressed in cream rather than gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivy is a climbing evergreen plant that clings to walls.

clue.text: Take a shine to groom in fun costume

parts.note: to fancy someone is to take a shine to them
to dress, as in dressing hair or a horse, is to groom

explanation.surface: Someone takes a liking to a bridegroom in a party costume.
explanation.walkthrough: 'groom' looks like a bridegroom, but it is the verb meaning to tidy up.
explanation.definitionFit: Fancy dress is a costume worn for amusement at a themed party.

clue.text: Wily, like ancient king, leader of Egyptians

parts.note: as means like
Tut, short for Tutankhamun, was a boy pharaoh of ancient Egypt

indicators.note: the front letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Cunning, as an ancient Egyptian ruler should be.
explanation.definitionFit: Astute means shrewd and canny, synonyms of wily.

clue.text: Labour pains

definitions.meaning: hard work or toil, as a noun
great efforts or trouble taken over something

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests childbirth, but the two words are separate senses of strenuous effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are about hard, effortful work: toil, and the trouble taken to do something.

clue.text: Not to mention bird's claw found in shelter

indicators.note: the claw is placed in the shelter letters

parts.note: the lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
a talon is the claw of a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A bird of prey's claw is discovered in a refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase introduces something even more extreme, an idiom meaning 'still less' or 'not to mention'.

clue.text: Drink freely by left luggage facility at 27

parts.note: to carouse is to drink heavily and make merry

explanation.surface: Someone drinks too much beside left-luggage at a terminal.
explanation.definitionFit: Baggage reclaim uses a rotating belt from which arriving passengers collect their bags.

clue.text: Figure runs home, not quite ahead of coach

indicators.note: the trimmed home comes before the coach

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: home is taken as written before trimming
a coach is a bus

explanation.surface: A sporting figure makes a home run before boarding the team coach.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhombus is a geometric shape, a parallelogram with four equal sides.

clue.text: Get the message about ending of aid, and lose one's temper

parts.note: to see is to understand
re means about or concerning

indicators.note: the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone learns that aid is ending, and becomes furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To see red is an idiom for becoming suddenly angry.

clue.text: Toy dog lost during short mass meeting

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come during the shortened meeting
the word is shortened by its last letter

parts.note: a rally is a mass gathering

indicators.note: lost means astray, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dog went missing in the middle of a brief large gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims RALLY to RALL, and 'lost' turns DOG into GDO.
explanation.definitionFit: A rag doll is a soft stuffed toy made of cloth.

clue.text: Meal about finished?

parts.note: re means about or concerning
past means over or finished

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether dinner is nearly over.
explanation.definitionFit: Repast is a formal word for a meal.

clue.text: Pair, uneasy at first, entering party

indicators.note: the letter enters the party word

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: the opening letter of the preceding word

explanation.surface: Two people arrive at a party, nervous at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: A duo is two people together, a pair.

clue.text: Almost her age, nun worried about head of order

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go about the single letter
worried means fretted or shaken up, so the letters are rearranged
the top letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A nun of nearly the same age frets about the head of her religious order.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means approximately, close to but not quite.

clue.text: Enthusiasts pulled up in shock

indicators.note: in a down entry, pulling up reads the word from the bottom

parts.note: nuts are fans, as in 'golf nuts'

explanation.surface: Fans are stopped, astonished.
explanation.definitionFit: To stun is to daze or astonish, so it means to shock.

clue.text: Ban therefore must include doctor, American

indicators.note: the therefore word must hold the other letters inside it

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A prohibition that requires a doctor from America.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban, especially on trade.

clue.text: Perhaps John Lennon tune on piano, or beginning of "Thriller"

parts.note: an air is a melody

indicators.note: the opening letter of the following word

clue.text: Say nothing about a small band

indicators.note: the quiet sound goes about the other letters

parts.note: sh is a call to be quiet

explanation.surface: A small band of musicians is told to keep quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: A sash is a band of cloth worn round the waist or over the shoulder.

clue.text: On tenth lap, running in athletics event

indicators.note: running about suggests the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: An athlete in a multi-sport contest is on the tenth lap of the race.
